```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}

# --- Helper: Log-likelihood ratio (G²) vs 50/50 (excluding pushes) ---
g2_50 <- function(O, U) {
  n <- O + U
  if (n == 0) return(c(G2 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  E <- n / 2
  term <- 0
  if (O > 0) term <- term + O * log(O / E)
  if (U > 0) term <- term + U * log(U / E)
  G2 <- 2 * term
  p  <- pchisq(G2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  c(G2 = G2, p = p)
}

# ---- Function to process a single season ----
analyze_season_series <- function(file_path, season_year) {

  message("\n---- Processing ", season_year, " ----")

  # Load data and clean
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Date = lubridate::mdy(Date),
      OU = dplyr::recode(`OU Result`,
                         "Over"="O","OVER"="O",
                         "Under"="U","UNDER"="U",
                         "Push"="P","PUSH"="P",
                         .default=`OU Result`),
      game_id = row_number()
    )

  # Each team appears once per game (as winner/loser)
  appear <- bind_rows(
    df %>% transmute(game_id, Date, Team = `Winning Team`, Opp = `Losing Team`, OU),
    df %>% transmute(game_id, Date, Team = `Losing Team`,  Opp = `Winning Team`, OU)
  ) %>%
    arrange(Team, Date) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    mutate(Series = cumsum(Opp != lag(Opp, default = first(Opp)))) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Limit to first 4 series per team
  first4 <- appear %>% filter(Series <= 4)

  # --- Aggregate O/U/P totals by series number ---
  by_series <- first4 %>%
    count(Series, OU, name = "n") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = OU, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Total = O + U + P,
      `U%` = round(100 * U / (O + U), 1),
      `Push%` = round(100 * P / Total, 1)
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(G2 = g2_50(O, U)[["G2"]],
           p = g2_50(O, U)[["p"]]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Series) %>%
    transmute(Label = paste0("Series ", Series),
              O, U, P, Total, `U%`, `Push%`, `G^2` = G2, `p-value` = p)

  # --- Add Season Totals ---
  season <- df %>%
    count(OU, name = "n") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = OU, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Total = O + U + P,
      `U%` = round(100 * U / (O + U), 1),
      `Push%` = round(100 * P / Total, 1)
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(G2 = g2_50(O, U)[["G2"]],
           p = g2_50(O, U)[["p"]]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Label = "Season") %>%
    select(Label, O, U, P, Total, `U%`, `Push%`, `G^2` = G2, `p-value` = p)

  # --- Combine ---
  bind_rows(by_series, season) %>%
    mutate(Year = season_year) %>%
    select(Year, everything())
}

# ---- Run for 2022–2024 ----
res22 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2022_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2022)
res23 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2023_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2023)
res24 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2024_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2024)

# Combine and print all results
final_results <- bind_rows(res22, res23, res24)
print(final_results, n = 50)

# Optional: Save to CSV
# write_csv(final_results, "MLB_AllSeries1-4_withPushes_2022-2024.csv")


```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------
# MLB Over/Under 3-Game Series Analysis (2022–2024)
# ---------------------------------------------

# --- Helper: Log-likelihood ratio (G²) vs 50/50 (pushes excluded) ---
g2_50 <- function(O, U) {
  n <- O + U
  if (n == 0) return(c(G2 = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  E <- n / 2
  term <- 0
  if (O > 0) term <- term + O * log(O / E)
  if (U > 0) term <- term + U * log(U / E)
  G2 <- 2 * term
  p  <- pchisq(G2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  c(G2 = G2, p = p)
}

# ---- Function to process a single season ----
analyze_season_series <- function(file_path, season_year) {

  message("\n---- Processing ", season_year, " ----")

  # Load data and clean
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Date = lubridate::mdy(Date),
      OU = dplyr::recode(`OU Result`,
                         "Over"="O","OVER"="O",
                         "Under"="U","UNDER"="U",
                         "Push"="P","PUSH"="P",
                         .default=`OU Result`),
      game_id = row_number()
    )

  # Each team appears once per game (as winner/loser)
  appear <- bind_rows(
    df %>% transmute(game_id, Date, Team = `Winning Team`, Opp = `Losing Team`, OU),
    df %>% transmute(game_id, Date, Team = `Losing Team`,  Opp = `Winning Team`, OU)
  ) %>%
    arrange(Team, Date) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    mutate(Series = cumsum(Opp != lag(Opp, default = first(Opp)))) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- Count and filter to 3-game series only ---
  series_counts <- appear %>%
    group_by(Team, Series) %>%
    tally(name = "Games")

  appear <- appear %>%
    left_join(series_counts, by = c("Team", "Series")) %>%
    filter(Games == 3) %>%
    select(-Games)

  # Report how many series were dropped
  total_series <- n_distinct(paste(series_counts$Team, series_counts$Series))
  kept_series  <- n_distinct(paste(appear$Team, appear$Series))
  dropped      <- total_series - kept_series
  message("Kept ", kept_series, " of ", total_series, " series (", dropped, " dropped)")

  # Limit to first 4 series per team
  first4 <- appear %>% filter(Series <= 4)

  # --- Aggregate O/U totals by series number ---
  by_series <- first4 %>%
    count(Series, OU, name = "n") %>%
    filter(OU %in% c("O","U")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = OU, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Total = O + U,
           `U%` = round(100 * U / Total, 1)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(G2 = g2_50(O, U)[["G2"]],
           p = g2_50(O, U)[["p"]]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Series) %>%
    transmute(Label = paste0("Series ", Series),
              O, U, Total, `U%`, `G^2` = G2, `p-value` = p)

  # --- Add Season Totals (3-game series only) ---
  season <- appear %>%
    count(OU, name = "n") %>%
    filter(OU %in% c("O","U")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = OU, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Total = O + U,
           `U%` = round(100 * U / Total, 1)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(G2 = g2_50(O, U)[["G2"]],
           p = g2_50(O, U)[["p"]]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Label = "Season") %>%
    select(Label, O, U, Total, `U%`, `G^2` = G2, `p-value` = p)

  # --- Combine and return ---
  bind_rows(by_series, season) %>%
    mutate(Year = season_year) %>%
    select(Year, everything())
}

# ---- Run for 2022–2024 ----
res22 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2022_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2022)
res23 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2023_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2023)
res24 <- analyze_season_series("mlb2024_results_with_OU_MINIMAL.csv", 2024)

# Combine and print all results
final_results <- bind_rows(res22, res23, res24)
print(final_results, n = 50)

# Optional: save to CSV
# write_csv(final_results, "MLB_3GameSeries1-4_FairBetResults_2022-2024.csv")

```
